digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Amazon Connect Wave 1 received GO approval today, while eight tracked actions still need follow-through. Tomorrow is anchored by the EOW update, pipeline decisions, executive status slides, and a new-project scoping call.

items.label: Carry the approved Amazon Connect Wave 1 launch into execution
items.detail: Today's go/no-go meeting approved GO for Wave 1. Record the decision, close the remaining launch mitigations, and protect the September 22 Columbus pilot; caller-ID selection remains a two-to-three-week constraint.

items.label: Lock Amazon Connect production ownership and support
items.detail: Confirm the dedicated Salesforce integration account and the internal support model before production. SaltClick remains the de facto support owner, leaving a single-point-of-support and added-spend risk.

items.label: Review the Supabase security alert
items.detail: Confirm the affected project and severity, then assign remediation or document why no immediate action is required.

items.label: Clear the overdue Rippling task
items.detail: A fresh alert today still showed one overdue company task. Confirm what remains, then complete or reassign it.

items.label: Set the CoE backlog and intake path for Sprint 19
items.detail: Coordinate the backlog review with Jill, notify submitters that Sprint 18 is full, and verify whether new requests belong with EPMO or CoE before scoping.

items.label: Clear the pending access approvals
items.detail: Decide Sara Rodriguez's Training Agenda access and review Armando's request in help desk ticket 0033237.

items.label: Launch the Attorney Review at Intake plan with Jhara
items.detail: Jhara is assigned as PM and the project has an October 15 deadline. Confirm scope, milestones, stakeholders, and the first dependency that needs escalation.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect training mitigation
items.detail: Confirm ownership for hands-on sessions, site champions, morning test calls, and the Monday/Wednesday/Friday completion cadence before Wave 1 begins.

items.label: RFE MHE Touchpoint was cancelled
items.detail: Mar will reschedule after an architect is assigned to walk the team through the available options.

items.label: Amazon Connect Wave 1 received GO approval
items.detail: The September 17 decision meeting approved moving forward with Wave 1, with known launch risks and mitigations still requiring follow-through.

items.label: A newly reviewed request will be handled as EPMO work
items.detail: Jean confirmed it belongs with EPMO rather than CoE. Autocomplete will be the initial phase, with removal handled as a later EPMO phase.

items.label: 10:30 AM - SVC standup; 11:00 AM - Laura 1:1
items.detail: Use the Laura conversation to revisit the paused SMS automation work after today's technical and legal inputs.

items.label: 12:00 PM - Blocked Space; 1:00 PM - EPMO EOW Check In
items.detail: The EOW meeting moved earlier and Nadia was added for programmatic updates, so finish the executive readout before lunch.

items.label: 2:30 PM - Project pipeline; 3:00 PM - Executive status slides
items.detail: Capture prioritization and IT-capacity decisions in the executive deck while the pipeline discussion is fresh.

items.label: 4:00 PM - New Clients Continuing the Process scoping call
items.detail: Clarify the new intake's scope and requirements with Matthew Wentzel so EPMO can determine the path forward.

items.label: Jhara is out of office
items.detail: Plan coverage for any time-sensitive Attorney Review at Intake follow-up.
